The Perceptual Quality Auditor's low noise score (0.2) contradicts the visual graininess, suggesting the 'noise' is stylistic or compression-related rather than generative artifacting. I agree with the Router's severity ratings but emphasize that the head accessory remains a significant structural anomaly.
